answer: Randomized audit-delay settlement resists sybils: rewards settle only after a randomized delay during which the work remains subject to retroactive audit, so a hit-and-run fake cannot earn and vanish before scrutiny. A meadow of fakes that minted and dumped is clawed back if a delayed audit flags them; the forge of fast extraction is quenched by the unpredictable settlement lag. A falcon-quick exit is impossible when payout waits behind a random audit window per identity, so sustaining fraud requires surviving audits on every fake across the full delay.
